🎬 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows (2016)

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows follows Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello, and Michelangelo as they continue protecting New York City from dangerous criminals while remaining hidden from the public. After their longtime enemy Shredder escapes police custody, the four brothers discover that he has joined forces with the mysterious alien warlord Krang, who plans to invade Earth using powerful technology from another dimension. To make matters worse, Shredder recruits two dangerous criminals, Bebop and Rocksteady, who are transformed into enormous mutant animals with incredible strength. With the city facing destruction, the turtles must work alongside their trusted friends April O’Neil, Casey Jones, and Vern Fenwick to stop the villains before it’s too late. However, disagreements within the team threaten their unity, forcing the brothers to learn the importance of trusting one another. Starring Megan Fox, Stephen Amell, Will Arnett, and Brian Tee, with voices from Pete Ploszek, Alan Ritchson, Jeremy Howard, and Noel Fisher, the film delivers explosive action, hilarious comedy, exciting adventures, and unforgettable lessons about brotherhood, teamwork, courage, and accepting who you truly are.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Science Fiction • Comedy • Superhero

⭐ IMDb: 5.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 52m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Dave Green

✍️ Writers: Josh Appelbaum & André Nemec

🎬 Studio: Paramount Pictures • Nickelodeon Movies

📚 Based On: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles characters created by Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird.

🐢 Film Series: Sequel to Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014).

📺 Where to Watch: Check Paramount+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.
